newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT-Boston Scientific FY97 cut.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT-Boston Scientific FY97 cut.

text.p: -- J.P. Morgan Securities Inc said Friday it cut its estimate for Boston Scientific Corp's fiscal 1997 earnings to $1.90 a share from $2.12, reduced the estimate for 1998 to $2.50 from $2.80 and lowered the 1999 estimate to $3.25 from $3.70. J.P. Morgan also cut its target price to $60.

-- Boston Scientific's "forward spend" program of the last year left the company with a higher cost structure that will penalize profitability and dampen earnings growth in the near- to intermediate-term, J.P. Morgan said.
-- Higher costs and lower margins are expected to offset high-growth for the first half of 1997, J.P. Morgan said.
-- J.P. Morgan said it maintained its buy rating in anticipation of an expected sell-off to $50 or lower.
-- Boston Scientific is a medical device developer.
-- Its shares were off 14-3/8 Friday at 46-1/8.
